Answer 9 — Our backups work through Pterodactyl’s cloud backup system integrated with Cloudflare R2 object storage. When a backup is created, the server compresses your files, worlds, plugins, and configurations into a secure archive and uploads it directly to off-site cloud storage. This keeps backups safe even if the game node experiences issues. Users can restore backups anytime directly from the panel, and since R2 uses object storage, backups are reliable, scalable, and optimized for large game servers.
